scenicChapters.title: Segment San Juan de Tantaranche - Huarochi → Segment Casila Alto - Chi
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 45 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-segment-portachuelo-laguna-escale.story: A 168 km round trip from Tanta - roughly 2 h 54 in the saddle. On the way it passes Segment San Juan de Tantaranche - Huarochi, Segment Casila Alto - Chillaco and back through Segment San Juan de Tantaranche - Huarochi. The highest point is about 4,700 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
